description: Give the brief for one Live job of find_jobs, for a given agent's AI, as Go mode's Jobs copies it, with no Go mode account needed: each paid tool with its method, address and the most to pay for one use, the free reads, the budget, the limits to run it within, how the client pays, and, when the agent's Priors line has room, the loan to ask its owner for with request_borrow and its repayment with request_repay. The agent pays each tool with pay_url from its own @priors/mcp. With api_url the client pays the agent's own x402 endpoint; without it the brief's last line says how to sell the job as the agent's own offer. Nothing is paid or borrowed here. Read-only.

agent_id.description: The agent that does the work (an ERC-8004 id).

api_url.description: Optional: the agent's own x402 endpoint the client pays (https).

job.description: The job's key, as find_jobs gives it, e.g. check-agents.

price_usd.description: What the client pays, in USDG (a month, for a recurring job). Default: the job's suggested price.

name: job_brief
title: A job's brief for an agent's AI
